ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell ADRecon Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of ADRecon.ps1 for AD reconnaissance which has been reported to be actively used by FIN7 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Function\\ Get\\-ADRExcelComOb.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ADRGPO.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ADRDomainController.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ADRecon\\-Report\\\.xlsx.*"))
